$comment: Which standards domains each plugin ships. A skill declares its domain in front matter; this maps domain to plugin. Generator input only - neither harness reads this file. It is not derivable from anything else: a plugin's name does not imply its domains, and a consumer installs per stack, so the split is a deliberate authored decision. The generator cross-checks it against marketplace.json both ways, so a plugin cannot be declared here and missing there, or the reverse, and against the skills both ways, so a domain cannot be claimed by no plugin or shipped with no skills. The 10 utility skills declare no domain and ship in no plugin - they are Tommy's machine tooling, delivered by deploy-skills.ps1 from this clone.
